title: Small Business Innovation Protection Act of 2017
official_summary:
Small Business Innovation Protection Act of 2017

(Sec. 4) This bill directs the Small Business Administration to develop partnership agreements that provide for:

  • development of high-quality training for small businesses related to domestic and international protection of intellectual property,
  • leveraging of training materials already developed for the education of inventors and small businesses, and
  • participation of a nongovernmental organization.

These agreements must also provide training:

  • through electronic resources, including Internet-based webinars; and
  • at physical locations, including a small business development center (SBDC) and the headquarters or a regional office of the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office.

(Sec. 5) The bill amends the Small Business Act to require services at an SBDC to include training, in person or through a website, relating to:

  • domestic and international intellectual property protections, and
  • how those protections should be considered in the business plans and growth strategies of small businesses.

summary.headline: A 2018 law directs the Small Business Administration to create intellectual property training for small businesses and inventors.
summary.what_it_does: The law tells the Small Business Administration to build partnership agreements that provide training on protecting intellectual property, such as patents and trademarks, both in the United States and abroad. The training can be delivered online, including webinars, or in person at Small Business Development Centers and at U.S. Patent and Trademark Office locations. It also requires Small Business Development Centers to offer training, in person or on a website, on how intellectual property protections fit into a small business's plans and growth strategy.

who_it_affects.how: They can receive training on domestic and international intellectual property protections, including through Small Business Development Centers and online.
Existing training materials made for inventors may be reused in the new small business training programs.

who_it_affects.group: People who use Small Business Development Centers for advice
who_it_affects.how: Those centers must include intellectual property training in the services they offer.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 9, 2018. The official summary does not give a separate start date for the training programs.
